XenotypeDef.label: carrionkin
XenotypeDef.description: The dark archotech intelligence Horax has not overlooked the jungle planet Phytok. After the phytokins were created, it captured a gauranlenkin, dragged her into the darkest laboratory in its metal hell, and fused her with one of its proudest creations: the harbinger tree. After this fusion, the new phytokin xenotype, known as carrionkin, lost the ability to photosynthesize and had to feed on raw meat and corpses. They can also continuously produce bioferrite, just as harbinger trees yield bioferrite when cut down.\n\nCreated by a dark archotech, fused with an anomaly entity, and able to eat only raw meat and corpses... These traits gave rise to rumors that carrionkin would savagely devour everyone and sacrifice them to Horax. However, because the entity fused into them was the uniquely gentle and harmless harbinger tree, carrionkin are actually kind and harmless, peaceful and friendly, and possess almost no combat ability. They excel at investigating anomalies but do not believe in conventional science. On any planet where anomalous phenomena have been reported, diligent, gentle carrionkin researchers can be found.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Carrionkin are phytokins modified by Horax, hybrids of phytokins and harbinger trees. They feed on raw meat and corpses and, like harbinger trees, can continuously produce bioferrite for the colony. Because the entity fused into them was the uniquely gentle and harmless harbinger tree, true carrionkin are kind and harmless, peaceful and friendly in temperament, and possess almost no combat ability.

XenotypeDef.label: harbingerkin
XenotypeDef.description:
When the dark archotech intelligence Horax created carrionkin, it simply combined harbinger tree genes with phytokin genes. The resulting carrionkin could convert corpses into bioferrite, just like harbinger trees themselves. However, being more mobile and more popular, carrionkin soon displaced harbinger trees from their ecological niche on most planets, bringing the trees close to extinction.

To protect its harbinger trees, Horax used carrionkin and other phytokins to create a new phytokin xenotype: harbingerkin. These xenohumans serve as the trees' external offensive organs. They cannot reproduce on their own and are instead produced by harbinger trees, like the soldier ants of a harbinger tree colony.

Although harbingerkin live in almost complete symbiosis with harbinger trees, they scarcely resemble phytokins. They are ugly, poor at growing plants, and aggressive fighters who are formidable on the battlefield, yet they never butcher corpses. Their purpose is to hunt down large quantities of corpses to support the reproduction of harbinger trees. They can also pulverize corpses into meat mush for the trees to absorb. As symbionts of harbinger trees, harbingerkin cannot produce bioferrite like carrionkin, but they share their level of satiation with the trees.

Created to address the disruption caused by carrionkin, harbingerkin always have a poor relationship with them, even though they share the same origins. Born of the same root, why are they so eager to destroy one another?
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Harbingerkin are fierce and combative, so ugly that they scarcely resemble phytokins, yet unstoppable on the battlefield. They are guardians of harbinger trees, living in almost complete symbiosis with them and even drawing nutrition from the trees to fill their stomachs. These female warriors worship Horax and will use any means to obtain corpses to feed the harbinger trees.
